artifacts.title: Upstream contribution flow
artifacts.notes: GitHub repo is a one-way mirror of self-hosted GitLab. Fork mirror -> DCO-signed commits -> PR on GitHub -> maintainer lands into GitLab with authorship preserved -> mirror syncs back, PR closed with pointer.
